user_story: As a guest, I want to create a booking with the maximum allowed guests (10) so that boundary values are handled correctly.

positive.title: Booking creation with maximum allowed guests
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest
Select the date and time for the booking
Input guest count as 10
Fill in other required booking details
Submit the booking form
positive.expected_result: Booking is successfully created for 10 guests with confirmation notification.

negative.title: Booking creation with more than maximum allowed guests
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest
Select the date and time for the booking
Input guest count as 11
Fill in other required booking details
Submit the booking form
negative.expected_result: Booking is not created and an error message is displayed indicating the maximum guest limit.

negative.title: Booking creation with zero guests
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest
Select the date and time for the booking
Input guest count as 0
Fill in other required booking details
Submit the booking form
negative.expected_result: Booking is not created and an error message is displayed indicating that at least one guest is required.

edge.title: Booking creation with minimum allowed guests (1)
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest
Select the date and time for the booking
Input guest count as 1
Fill in other required booking details
Submit the booking form
edge.expected_result: Booking is successfully created for 1 guest with confirmation notification.

edge.title: Booking creation with maximum allowed guests just below the limit (9)
steps: Navigate to the booking page as a guest
Select the date and time for the booking
Input guest count as 9
Fill in other required booking details
Submit the booking form
edge.expected_result: Booking is successfully created for 9 guests with confirmation notification.
